# 2 Oct 2026 (GAPS-fr4715-vieuville-pool, account-4): the four '?' tokens (L18/17, L23/16, L27/20, L31/9) settled from the crops by pass C (witness/f67r_pass_c.tsv, Fable 5.1 blind read, 4 calls) and pass D (witness/f67r_disagreements_pass_d.tsv, call 5); the clear-word tokens below are still the A/B reconciliation (51.4 pct agreement) -- pass C's reading of the clear French (H 327 / M 201 / L 102 of 630 words) is in witness/f67r_pass_c.tsv and is NOT folded in here; L31/9 is a clear word, so the cipher-token count is 27, not 28.

# token: w:word = clear French as read (conf = the lower of the two passes); digits = a cipher group; a leading '.' = a bar or dot over the group (the word-code layer, not in the letter key); '?' = the passes disagree (both readings in note), conf L, settled only from the image.

# 2 Oct 2026 (GAPS-fr4715-vieuville-pool-6, account-4): clear-word frame replaced by pass C's words, confidence from three-pass support (scripts/f67r_frame_fold.py: C 609 words, A or B agree 341, H 325 / M 86 / L 198); cipher tokens unchanged; lines kept as before: L31 (current 0 cipher runs, C 1).

# 2 Oct 2026 (GAPS-fr4715-vieuville-pool-9, account-4): L-word pass (scripts/f67r_lword_pass.py): two blind Opus 5.5 readers on masked slots; an old L word both write -> H; a slot both readers agree on against the old reading is replaced at M only when the reconciler picks it; cipher tokens unchanged.
